en: I have only just arrived in London.
We've had nothing but trouble lately as it is.
If you don't want to look suspicious, hurry along home.
Hm...? Oh, it's you.
I nearly took you for a suspicious character.
You look like you could melt right into the dark.
Just like the killer who has London in an uproar:
gone without a trace after every crime.
Honestly, all this extra investigating is a real headache for me.
, is it? Good evening.
note: after name: 'Chris, is it? Good evening.'

en: I'm on night patrol again. It's exhausting.
If only the townsfolk would form a watch or
help out, it'd make my job much easier
note: followed by #152 '...'. #963 (slice 012, msg 30251) is the same line with 。 and should read 'help out, it'd make my job much easier.'

en: That's too much to ask, I guess. Sigh, I'm beat.
If you see anyone strange, do let me know.
What's the matter? Directions? Looking for someone?
I would like to ask the way...
If it's directions, there's a map right here, so
help yourself.
I'm busy with my nightly patrols and reports.
Daytime's fine, but at night this city's unsafe.
So you'd best be very careful.
Sigh, so busy... Mutter, mutter
Yes, what is it... Oh, you. What do you want?
You hardly look like a victim. You look more
like the type who'd go and cause trouble.
You seem busy every day, Constable Colin.
I was passing by, so I thought I'd drop in.
Too right. I'm so busy my head's spinning.
Pickpockets, burglars, the Ripper
My whole day goes on writing up the cases.
What's this, you again...? Give me a break.
I'm a busy man, you know.
You've been going all over, poking around.
Are you a relative of a recent victim or such?
Or perhaps
Oh, it's you. Hard at it every day, I see.
I don't know what you're after, but keep at it.
Whatever it is, you're a keen one, I'll say that.
Sigh, call it diligence or call it zeal
Walking all over town daily, are you all right?
You'd make a better policeman than I do.
Truth is, I'm not a very conscientious man.
I'm utterly worn down by how busy it's been.
I almost wish you'd take my place. Sigh.
Ahh, being a policeman is a thankless job.
Criminals and citizens just run me ragged.
Hmm... And who might you be?
What's your business? I'm an officer. I won't
overlook anything shady. State your name.
You are mistaken. I am no one suspicious.
This is my first time in London.
Hmph... I see. Did some noble send you here,
a detective or something of the sort?
Looking into crimes is police work, you know.
Well, I'm off duty right now myself.
Whatever you do is no concern of mine.
What is it? Did you see something suspicious?
Report it while I'm on duty, would you?
... wasn't it?
You seem to be wandering all over the place.
Detective or seeking someone, whatever it is,
just don't go causing any big commotion.
I'd rather you didn't add to my workload.
Come on now, I'm busy every single day.
Please, at least let me rest when I'm at home.
Oh, all right. Care to stay for some tea?
I know you're not a bad sort.
I can't be warm, but you're welcome here.
I suppose I'm not cut out to be a policeman.
I'm lazy by nature. When it gets this busy,
note: #976 (slice 012, msg 30630) is the same line without 。: same English.

en: I get sick and tired of the whole thing.
Come again if you like. I won't turn you away.
I'm nobody suspicious, honestly.
I've only just come to London.
I'm Constable Colin.
Avoid any suspicious behavior.
You haven't seen anything strange, have you?
I don't need any more work piled on me.
I'm not anyone suspicious, really.
